issue_context.title: [Bug]: When emulating iOS devices, WebKit orientation is always landscape-primary.
issue_context.body:
### Version

1.44.1

### Steps to reproduce

1. clone my repo https://github.com/ohryhurko/pw-orientation-sendbox/tree/main
2. run `npm install`
3. run `npx playwright test --project="Mobile Safari"`
4. run `npx playwright test --project="Mobile Chrome"`

### Expected behavior

The tests should pass successfully. The expected orientation for both devices is `portrait-primary`.

### Actual behavior

Tests for `Mobile Safari` are failing because, for `webkit`, the orientation is always `landscape-primary`.

### Additional context

I encountered this problem when writing tests for my application. It checks `screen.orientation.type` and displays the application differently depending on the type. When trying to identify the cause, I discovered that no matter what viewport is specified for testing on `webkit`, the orientation is always `landscape-primary`

### Environment

```shell
System:
 OS: MacOS Sonoma 14.5
 Chip: Apple M2 Max
 Total Number of Cores: 12 (8 performance and 4 efficiency)
Binaries:
 Node: 18.17.1
 NPM: 9.6.7
npmPackages:
@playwright/test: "^1.44.1"
```
